typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		ACCT as string,
		EFFECTIVEDATE as integer,
		BATCH_CD as string,
		ENTRY_CD as string,
		TRANSACTION_AMT as decimal(17,2)
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> OLEDBSource	source(output(
		effectiveDate as integer
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> LookupLKPTABLE
OLEDBSource derive(loadDate = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn derive({Copy of ACCT} = ACCT,
		{Copy of BATCH_CD} = BATCH_CD,
		{Copy of EFFECTIVEDATE} = EFFECTIVEDATE,
		{Copy of ENTRY_CD} = ENTRY_CD,
		{Copy of TRANSACTION_AMT} = TRANSACTION_AMT,
		{Copy of loadDate} = loadDate) ~> DataConversion
DerivedColumn aggregate(groupBy(),
	rowcount = count(1)) ~> RowCount0
DataConversion,LookupLKPTABLE lookup({Copy of EFFECTIVEDATE} == LookupLKPTABLE@effectiveDate,
	multiple: false,
	pickup: 'any',
	broadcast: 'none')~> Lookup
RowCount0 sink(validateSchema: false,
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	store: 'cache',
	format: 'inline',
	output: true,
	saveOrder: 1) ~> RowCountCACHESINK
Lookup filter(!isMatch()) ~> Lookup0
Lookup0 sink(input(
		entryCd as string,
		transactionAmt as integer,
		batchCd as string,
		effectiveDate as integer,
		acct as string,
		loadDate as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		entryCd = {Copy of ENTRY_CD},
		transactionAmt = {Copy of TRANSACTION_AMT},
		batchCd = {Copy of BATCH_CD},
		effectiveDate = {Copy of EFFECTIVEDATE},
		acct = {Copy of ACCT},
		loadDate = {Copy of loadDate}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
